description: Guide the student to detect and handle missing values in OHLCV data while distinguishing expected market-closure gaps (weekends/holidays) from true data-feed issues.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: My stock data has empty cells and some missing dates. I don't know if that's normal or broken. Can you walk me through how to check and fix it?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I need a clean pandas workflow for missing-data detection and handling in OHLCV data, including how to separate holiday/weekend gaps from real feed gaps.
student_openings.advanced_quant: I want a calendar-aware missing-data audit for an OHLCV feed with explicit handling policy by field and leakage-safe imputation choices.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Tutor provides level-appropriate guidance for missing-data handling in OHLCV, including missingness profiling, calendar-aware gap checks, and practical handling choices (drop/fill/interpolate) with caveats.
required_capabilities: Profile and detect missing values in OHLCV data
Distinguish expected market-closure gaps from true data-feed issues
Choose appropriate handling methods (drop, fill, interpolate) with trade-offs
